Dai stablecoin is a crypto-collateralized stablecoin designed to track the US dollar. Dai stablecoin is issued through smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Dai stablecoin is backed by over-collateralized crypto assets locked in the Maker protocol. Dai stablecoin is governed by holders of the MKR governance token. Dai stablecoin operates without a central intermediary that holds user funds.

Aave is a non-custodial lending and borrowing protocol. Aave runs on public blockchains through smart contracts. Aave pools user deposits into liquidity pools that borrowers can draw on. Aave offers flash loans that must be borrowed and repaid within a single blockchain transaction. Aave is governed by holders of the AAVE governance token. Aave is open source.

Polygon is a scaling framework for Ethereum. Polygon operates as a proof-of-stake sidechain that is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine. Polygon processes transactions off the Ethereum main chain while settling to Ethereum. Polygon uses the MATIC token for transaction fees and staking.

Binance DEX is a decentralized exchange built on the Binance Chain. Binance DEX matches trades through an on-chain order book. Binance DEX allows users to trade tokens directly from their own wallets without a custodial intermediary.

Synthetix is a protocol for issuing synthetic assets that track the price of other assets. Synthetix runs on the Ethereum blockchain through smart contracts. Synthetix requires users to stake the SNX token as collateral for issuing synthetic assets. Synthetix is governed by SNX token holders.
